verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an AI use-case heading, "Investigate What Changed After a Deploy". It suggests an AI agent working through SigNoz's MCP server can compare telemetry before and after a deploy, but nothing shows native release or change tracking. Missing for 10: native deployment/release markers or annotations on dashboards and charts, configuration-change event ingestion, version-tagged regression comparison, detailed docs beyond a heading, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
